courses.note: Passage prohibits borrowing from artificial intelligences but encourages using LLMs to understand course topics. Catalog page lists CSC 345 among the core courses (course list on the BS page; catalog.arizona.edu program page strips course lists). CSC 345 is the algorithms-and-analysis course in the core.

The BS core is CSC 252, 335, 345, 352, 380. No software engineering course or capstone is required. CSC 335 (Object-Oriented Programming and Design) is the nearest software-design course but is not a software engineering course.
